text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeeaaaaah! Everyone was so radiant! To! The! MAX!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm sooo happy I was able to have a serious match with other Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, I took first place! I must accept my victory with g-g-g-grace!
choice_data_list: Let's do it again next race too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, I took first place! I must accept my victory with g-g-g-grace!
choice_data_list: Let's do it again next race too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-y-y-y-y-you can't mean that! I'm supposed to be invisible like air…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You should be focusing on the amazing performances the other racers put on!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know that… but… the other runners are far more incredible than me, no matter how you look at it. So…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It… It just doesn't feel right getting compliments! You know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm gonna get much, much stronger so I can win the next one just like this time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And then, the races will keep heating up, and I'll be right on the frontlines to see my favs in all their glory!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wh-which basically means… there's still more in store for me! True ecstasy awaits!
